name: M6.Coordinates.block_reconstruct
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), p.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) → M6.Coordinates.blockPolynomial N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N p) = p
queries: AdjoinRoot quotient mk power basis ZMod finite sum
guidance: sum of coefficients C*X^i for i<N reconstructs degree<N polynomial. Fin indices cast into ZMod have val=i. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
